# Intent (intent-css)

> Intent is an intent-based CSS styling system. Markup uses a closed vocabulary of 44
> semantic role classes (what an element IS); a compiled theme decides what each role
> looks like. One OKLCH brand hue seeds the entire palette, spacing derives from
> named relationships instead of pixel values, light/dark mode is automatic via
> light-dark(), responsiveness uses container queries, and a design linter audits
> markup and WCAG contrast at build time. License: FSL-1.1-MIT (source-available,
> converts to MIT two years per release).

Key facts:
- Install: `npm install intent-css` (Node >= 20, zero runtime dependencies)
- CLI: `intent init` (scaffolds intent.config.mjs + AGENTS.md), `intent build`
  (scan sources, emit stylesheet), `intent check [--json]` (design lint + WCAG
  contrast audit, exit 1 on errors), `intent vocab [--json]` (the vocabulary as data)
- Config seeds: brand hue/chroma, space base+ratio, type base+ratio, radius,
  density, collapse width, contrast minimums
- Never write CSS values in markup: no inline styles, no utility classes, no
  media queries, no dark-mode variants
- Spacing = wrap siblings in stack-*/row-* and let the gap express the
  relationship (related / separate / sectioned)
- One action-primary per action scope (card, form, nav, dialog) — linted
- Responsive = `adaptive` on a wrapper + `collapse` on rows (container queries)

## Vocabulary (role — meaning)

Surfaces (exclusive): surface — default plane; surface-raised — lifted plane;
surface-sunken — recessed plane; surface-overlay — floating plane (dialogs);
card — self-contained raised block with border, radius, padding.

Actions (exclusive): action-primary — THE action of a container (one per scope);
action-secondary — supporting action; action-quiet — low-emphasis action;
action-danger — destructive action.

Text (exclusive): text-hero — the one fluid statement that owns the page;
text-display — hero statement; text-title — page/section title; text-heading —
subsection/card heading; text-body — reading text; text-caption — small
supporting text; eyebrow — small tracked uppercase section label. Modifiers:
muted — de-emphasized but readable (>= 4.5:1); faint — decorative only (>= 3:1).

Stacks (exclusive): stack-related / stack-separate / stack-sectioned — vertical
flow at increasing semantic distance. Rows (exclusive): row-related /
row-separate — horizontal equivalents.

Layout: grid-collection — responsive grid of equivalent items; adaptive — marks
a container-query container; collapse — row becomes a stack in narrow
containers; wrap — allow wrapping; spread — space-between; center — center
children and text; full — full width; measure — cap line length at 65ch.

Insets (exclusive): inset-compact / inset-related / inset-separate — padding roles.

Notes (exclusive): note-info / note-success / note-warn / note-danger — feedback
callouts with audited color pairs.

Controls & misc: field — input/select/textarea; chip — inline pill for tags and
metadata; divider — hairline; interactive — hover affordance for clickable
surfaces; selected — chosen item in a set; sr-only — visually hidden,
screen-reader accessible.

## Agent workflow

After editing markup: run `npx intent build` then `npx intent check --json`;
fix every diagnostic with severity "error" (rules: unknown-intent,
conflicting-roles, duplicate-primary, inline-style; plus theme contrast
failures) and re-run until ok=true / exit code 0.
